edumetrics.title: EduMetrics
edumetrics.description: Student performance analytics platform that imports assessment files, normalizes data, and produces class insights and printable reports.
edumetrics.useCase: Schools can turn heterogeneous CSV, Excel, and ODS assessment data into student, subject, and term views.
edumetrics.engineeringFocus: File-mapping workflows, deterministic analytics, report exports, and temporary upload cleanup.
edumetrics.stack: Python, FastAPI, pandas, React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Recharts
edumetrics.imageAlt: Illustration of student assessment analytics with class performance charts.

react-movie-app.title: React Movie App
react-movie-app.description: Movie discovery sample integrating TMDB search and Appwrite-backed search analytics.
react-movie-app.useCase: Explore movie information and trending searches in a responsive discovery interface.
react-movie-app.engineeringFocus: Debounced API search, external service configuration, and persisted search analytics.
react-movie-app.stack: React 19, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Appwrite, TMDB API

weather-app.title: Weather Forecast and History
weather-app.description: WeatherAPI sample that presents current conditions, a three-day forecast, and four days of historical data.
weather-app.useCase: Search for a city and compare current, forecast, and recent historical weather.
weather-app.engineeringFocus: Server-side API-key handling and combining current, forecast, and historical responses.
weather-app.stack: JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Node.js, Express, WeatherAPI

movie-watch-list.title: Movie Watch List
movie-watch-list.description: A browser-based movie search and watchlist app using the OMDb API and local storage.
movie-watch-list.useCase: Search for movies, inspect details, and save titles to a personal watchlist.
movie-watch-list.engineeringFocus: REST API responses, client-side state persistence, and a two-page search/watchlist flow.
movie-watch-list.stack: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, OMDb API, localStorage
movie-watch-list.imageAlt: Illustration of a movie search and saved watchlist interface.

menu-cart.title: Cart-Menu
menu-cart.description: Restaurant menu and cart demo with item selection, order totals, and a simulated checkout flow.
menu-cart.useCase: Select menu items, adjust an order, review totals, and step through a demonstration checkout.
menu-cart.engineeringFocus: Client-side cart state, total calculation, input validation, and responsive presentation.

task-list.title: Task List
task-list.description: React task-list app with task creation, completion, deletion, sorting, and animated visual feedback.
task-list.useCase: Organize tasks, mark completed items, and sort a personal task list.
task-list.engineeringFocus: Interactive component state, task sorting, and responsive UI behavior.
task-list.imageAlt: Illustration of a task organizer with a checklist and progress indicator.
